cohort: All singleton births in Sweden from 2001 to 2013 (950,301 pregnancies)
finding: Anxiety/depression was associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes (e.g. preeclampsia, instrumental delivery, elective and emergency caesarean section) and lower birth weight and gestational age in offspring.
mod_finding: Women with anxiety/depression diagnosis who were untreated had higher odds of elective CS compared to women on medication.
